scientific_limitations: The exact two-sign Bayes risk holds for deterministic distinct interior times and noiseless zero-threshold signs of a standard Brownian bridge. Unique placement optimality is proved only among reflection-symmetric time pairs; no global asymmetric-placement result. No adaptive/noisy/variable-threshold claims. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact two-sign Brownian-bridge occupation quadrature and a unique symmetric design
